_README: Copy to config/credentials.json (gitignored) and replace every value.
Environment variables win over this file; see .env.example for the name
of each one and what breaks without it.
Every section below has a reader, and tests/test_configuration.py resolves each one. Until 0.2.0, 'mcp' and 'oauth' did not:
settings.py read storage/semantic_gate/a2a, and AuthConfig read the
environment only, so filling in oauth.client_secret configured nothing and
nothing said so. AuthConfig.load() is the reader those two were missing.
Placeholders are deliberately unmistakable - REPLACE_ME, sk-ant-PLACEHOLDER,
https://issuer.example.invalid. A plausible-looking fake is worse than an
obvious one, because it survives review. An empty string means 'not
configured' and is reported as such; a placeholder left in place is
scripts/_packaging.py refuses to archive config/credentials.json even if
somebody force-adds it to git, and scans the bytes of every packaged file

anthropic._note: Environment ANTHROPIC_API_KEY wins over this. A placeholder value is refused loudly rather than sent.

openai._note: OPENAI_BASE_URL points at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and changes who receives the prompt; maxey0-ss.deployment reports when it is not the default.

huggingface._note: Hub reads work without this; inference does not.

oauth._note: issuer, audience, jwks_url and role_claim configure MAXEY0_AUTH_MODE=oidc (a missing one refuses with -32004/501). client_id and client_secret are stored and reported as inert: nothing consumes them.

storage._note: Recorded and reported. No provider is implemented; each appears under `inert` in maxey0-ss.deployment.

semantic_gate._warning: Naming a provider this build does not implement makes the gate FAIL CLOSED: every SCW-bound tool call is refused. Deliberate. A deployment asking for stricter gating is never answered with less. Use "disabled" for structural address validation only.
